text:
maria: deploy-bot failed to publish redwood/worker:2026.04.2 — manifest push error referencing a platform blob missing in the regional mirror. logs pasted.

deploy-bot: Publish failed for `redwood/worker:2026.04.2`
```
level=error msg="manifest push failed" err="blob referenced in manifest (sha256:ab12cd...) not found in us-east-1" status=409
```

samir: quick triage: looks like the arm64 layer never finished uploading from builder-03. `docker push --all-platforms` sometimes retries but registry returned 5xx mid-upload.

jess: can we pause the canary? floating tag is risky until we confirm all arches present.

maria: yes pause. Canary id=canary-77 holding.

ops-bot: Canary paused for redwood/worker:2026.04.2 (canary-77)

samir: did a `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/worker --image-ids imageTag=2026.04.2` — amd64 present, arm64 404.

maria: options:
- rollback canary to sha256:aa1111 (fast)
- attempt repush of missing layer and rebuild manifest list
- publish single-arch tag for canary while we fix multi-arch

jess: +1 rollback now. we don't want partial manifests in prod.

samir: rolling back with pinned digest:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/worker worker=redwood/worker@sha256:aa1111
```

ops-bot: Rollback executed by @samir at 2026-04-12T14:05:10Z 1: canary reverted to sha256:aa1111

maria: for repush plan: build same image, push amd64 then arm64, validate each via `aws ecr batch-get-image`, then publish manifest list. also create ephemeral tag `2026.04.2-republish-1` to avoid race with floating tag.

samir: will run republish pipeline and add sleeps between arch pushes. also add `skopeo inspect` to confirm manifest before final push.

ci-bot: Triggered pipeline: pipeline/worker/republish-2026.04.2 (run 5021)

samir: build finished. pushing amd64 -> ok. waiting 30s, pushing arm64 -> got 503 during blob PUT but retried and succeeded.

samir: validated both images present in us-east-1. pushing manifest list now.

deploy-bot: Publish succeeded for `redwood/worker:2026.04.2` -> manifest digest sha256:ef334b...

deploy-bot: Post-publish checks:
- multi-arch manifest contains amd64 & arm64
- replication status: us-east-1 -> eu-central-1: complete

maria: good. @ops-bot please resume canary with gradual ramp (10% -> 50% by 5m steps) and auto-abort on error.

ops-bot: Canary resumed: 10% -> next step at 5m intervals. auto-abort enabled.

jess: add release note: "Republished redwood/worker:2026.04.2 after missing arm64 blob prevented initial manifest push. Canary paused and rolled back; republish validated across regions; rollout resumed."

maria: also set a 90-minute change window in release notes to prevent auto-deploy of floating tag while we watch replication.

samir: added `2026.04.2-republish-1` ephemeral tag and left tag cleanup task in release checklist.

sre-oncall: checked replication at 14:40Z, no lingering mirror errors. will monitor metrics for 1hr.

maria: closing thread once SRE clears. thanks everyone :party_parrot:

sre-oncall: replication stable at 15:02Z, no follow-ups.

maria: closing. :white_check_mark:
